title: Booking draft
description: A Booking the Intake agent filled in from a Shipper's pasted text (version 1). It is not a Booking until the Shipper reviews and submits it. A value the text does not give is left out of the booking and listed as missing; every value that is there has the quote it came from.

booking.description: The booking's fields as the booking schema has them. Every field is optional.

quotes.description: For each field that is filled in, the words of the text it came from, verbatim. The key is the field's name, or items.<index>.<name> for a field of an item.

missing.description: The fields the text does not give or gives ambiguously, each with the reason. The key is named as in quotes.

kind.description: Optional. `missing`: the text does not give the field. `ambiguous`: the text gives it in a way the agent could not settle, such as two weights; the Shipper is asked to check it. Absent means `missing`.

ignored.description: Short pieces of the text the agent did not use, each verbatim, such as a signature or a disclaimer, so nothing disappears silently. Optional.
